# graphrt CLI release archives the desktop downloads on demand for "Put it online"
# (src-tauri/build.rs compiles them into the app; see src-tauri/src/deploy/cli_release.rs).
#
# Written by `scripts/pin-graphrt-cli.sh <version>` from the release's SHA256SUMS; do not edit
# by hand. One line per release target: `<sha256>  <asset name>  <size in bytes>`, asset names
# without the version (https://github.com/BimaPangestu28/graphrt/releases/tag/v<version>):
#   graphrt-aarch64-apple-darwin.tar.gz       graphrt-x86_64-apple-darwin.tar.gz
#   graphrt-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl.tar.gz  graphrt-aarch64-unknown-linux-musl.tar.gz
#   graphrt-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.zip
# build.rs refuses a pin that misses any of them.
#
# PLACEHOLDER: no graphrt release with `graphrt deploy --direct` (and its matching
# ghcr.io/bimapangestu28/graphrt:<version> image) exists yet, so scripts/graphrt-cli-version
# says `unreleased` and no archive is listed. The app then says online deploy is not
# available yet.
